title: Claude Motion Designer Showreel (hot orange)
summary: A 15 s motion-design showreel in a strict three-colour system: hot orange, ink navy-black and cobalt blue, with warm off-white. A dot on a dotted grid stretches into a line, then an orange band wipes the screen for 'CLAUDE. motion designer'. It then runs through a 3D extruded block wave with a chrome orb, a kinetic word sequence 'EVERY / SINGLE / FRAME' on alternating grounds, a data infographic (+311%), particle fields, a rebuilt render-queue UI card, a liquid blob, and back to the dot for the end card. Every frame has a mono HUD (scene 03/07, timecode, section label).
fit_reason: Strong, ownable 3-colour system and kinetic word sequence are reusable for launches; the showreel variety (3D, particles, blobs) is more agency than B2B.

palette.mood: high-contrast: hot orange, cobalt, ink and warm paper, flat with soft vignette

typography.display: ultra-bold condensed-ish grotesk caps (Druk Wide / Archivo Black style) + serif italic subline
typography.size_behaviour: huge centred single word per beat; tiny mono HUD
typography.notes: Full-stop dot in 'CLAUDE.' is a separate circle. 'SINGLE' sits in orange over a repeating outline-text pattern. 'FRAME' sits inside viewfinder corner brackets with '1920 x 1080' and '60 FPS' labels. Serif italic 'motion designer' / 'on purpose.' with hand-drawn underline.

text_animation: letters rise from baseline mask with stagger
full stop dot drops in last with bounce
one word per beat with hard cuts (EVERY → SINGLE → FRAME)
outline text pattern scrolls behind the hero word
serif italic writes on with underline stroke
motion: dot → line stretch → full-width band wipe
3D extruded cube field waving with chrome orb and orbit ring
particle flow fields and dot rings
liquid blob with orbiting black dots
bar chart grows with last bar orange
UI card toggle click with cursor
graphic_elements: HUD corner frame with scene counter and timecode
ui_treatment: One rebuilt UI card (Render queue: motion blur toggle, frame rate, black Render button) on blue with ghost cards behind.

sound.sfx: whoosh on wipes, impacts on word hits, clicks
sound.sync: word sequence cut exactly on beats

signature_moves: strict 3-colour system (orange / ink / cobalt) flipping ground each beat
dot that stretches into a line and wipes into the title
HUD frame with scene x/07 counter on every shot

best_segments.what: Dot on grid → line → orange band wipe → 'CLAUDE.' letters rise + italic subline
EVERY / SINGLE / FRAME on alternating grounds, then +311% infographic
Render-queue UI card toggle click, liquid blob, dot end card

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP/Remotion for type, wipes, infographic and UI card; 3D block wave needs Three.js; HUD frame as a reusable overlay component.
recreate.prompt: Three-colour motion reel (hot orange #fd4b20, ink, cobalt): a dot stretches into a line and wipes into a huge bold title with an italic serif subline, then EVERY / SINGLE / FRAME one word per beat on flipping grounds, a stat infographic and a floating UI card, all inside a thin mono HUD frame.
